description: Fetch the column schema for a data source. Useful before asking run_analysis about specific columns. The schema is derived from the preprocessing metadata clariBI extracted when the source was last synced. Poll this after upload_data_source / ingest_url_data_source until the returned status flips to "active" — that means preprocessing has finished and run_analysis will see the data.

data_source_id.description: UUID of the data source to fetch the schema for.

name: get_data_source_schema

schema.description: Schema-shaped fields the preprocessing pipeline wrote into the source metadata (columns, column_types, sample_rows, row_count, ...). Empty until preprocessing has run or for source types with no column inventory.
